provenance.notes: Captured from saved classifier run 36806 (auction_lot 17952, model null, 2026-11-03T23:09:32.496Z). Production rationale: This is a single marketed Strathearn single malt, not an out-of-scope item. The inspected local candidate 69250 is a different release: Release No. 7, cask 001, 50.9% ABV. The source’s cask identifier remains disputed, so neither matching that candidate nor creating a new exact-cask Bottle is safe. The run predates reading Scotch Whisky Auctions lot pages (#1609), so the evidence pack adds the lot page text. Expected outcome checked against the lot page and photo on 2026-11-09, in a random sample of the 185th auction's no_match reviews. Entity 280 (Strathearn, distillery, checked in production 2026-11-10) was added to the inspected Entities so the eval's Entity search returns it, as production search does.

expected.summary: Create Thompson Bros Strathearn 2013 9-year-old, Spirited Angels release 6: distilled 01.11.2013, French oak cask number 10, 53.4%, 47 bottles.
